user.title: Stockpot
user.description: Signing in to Stockpot ({url}) could not start. Fix the problem below, then submit to try again.

reauth_manual.title: Access lost
reauth_manual.description: The manual token of {url} no longer works. Sign in with Stockpot (recommended: the entry switches to the sign-in), or paste a new token if this Home Assistant cannot finish the sign-in.

reauth_oauth.title: Sign in again
reauth_oauth.description: Home Assistant no longer has access to {url} (access revoked, expired or account removed from the household). Sign in with Stockpot to restore it.

reauth_confirm.title: New token
reauth_confirm.description: Token with the « ha » ability for {url} (Stockpot > Settings > Home Assistant).

reconfigure_manual.title: Stockpot
reconfigure_manual.description: This entry ({url}) uses a manual token. Sign in with Stockpot (the entry switches to the sign-in), or change the address, the token or the SSL check.

menu_options.reconfigure_token: Change address, token or SSL check

reconfigure_oauth.title: Stockpot
reconfigure_oauth.description: Sign in with Stockpot again to renew the access of this household ({url}).

reconfigure_token.title: Stockpot
reconfigure_token.description: Change the address, the token or the SSL check of this household.

error.ssl_error: The TLS certificate of Stockpot was refused.
error.missing_ability: This token does not have the « ha » ability. Create one in Stockpot > Settings > Home Assistant.
error.two_factor_required: This household requires two-factor authentication: enable it on the token's account.
error.household_forbidden: This token is bound to another household, or the account is not a member of it.
error.not_stockpot: No Stockpot sign-in found at this address.
error.oauth_unsupported: This Stockpot does not offer Home Assistant sign-in yet: it must be updated.
error.insecure_endpoint: This Stockpot is on https but advertises an http sign-in endpoint: refused (downgrade). Check its APP_URL.
error.http_public_host: Plain http is only accepted for a local address (loopback, private network, .local…). Use https.
error.my_required: The My Home Assistant integration is not enabled: Stockpot redirects to my.home-assistant.io after sign-in. Enable it (default_config or my:). If your Stockpot administrator added this Home Assistant's address to STOCKPOT_OAUTH_HA_REDIRECT_HOSTS, submit again to continue.

abort.wrong_instance: This token or account belongs to another Stockpot instance or household than this entry. To add another household, add the integration again: new entries connect to stockpot.arakeo.com only.
abort.two_factor_required: This household requires two-factor authentication: enable it on your Stockpot account.
abort.already_in_progress: This household is already being added. Finish the existing configuration first.
abort.oauth_unauthorized: Stockpot refused the sign-in (code expired or invalid). Try again.
abort.user_rejected_authorize: Access refused on the Stockpot screen.
abort.oauth_failed: Error while obtaining the access token from Stockpot.
abort.oauth_timeout: Timeout while obtaining the access token from Stockpot.
abort.authorize_url_timeout: Timeout while preparing the Stockpot sign-in.
abort.no_url_available: No URL available for this Home Assistant: set its address in Settings > System > Network.

init.title: Stockpot panel
init.description: Stockpot in the Home Assistant sidebar, signed in with the Stockpot account that connected this integration (actions in the panel are made in its name). Administration (household settings, people, account) opens in Stockpot.

data_description.panel_enabled: Adds « Stockpot » to the sidebar. Needs the « Sign in with Stockpot » connection, with the panel allowed in Stockpot.
data_description.panel_admin_only: Only Home Assistant administrators see the panel.

panel_requires_oauth.title: Stockpot panel needs « Sign in with Stockpot »
panel_requires_oauth.description: The household « {title} » is connected with a manual token, which cannot open the Stockpot panel. Open Settings › Devices & services › Stockpot › Reconfigure, then choose « Sign in with Stockpot ». Or turn the panel off in the integration's options.
